title: Orunmila session header, schema version 1
description: Every session's raw log begins with a header record, and the hash chain starts from it. It records everything needed to reproduce the session's results. Replay reads these values from the header, never from current settings.
$comment: brief v3 line 282 lists what the header holds but names no fields: every field name here is the agent's choice (LD16). Draft from Phase 1 slice A1; built in slice A10. Unknown fields are allowed (line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as the header, so a reader tells it from a mark without guessing.

seq.description: The header is the first record of the raw log; marks follow from seq 1.
seq.$comment: brief v3 lines 237, 282; 0 for the header is the agent's choice, LD10

observed_at.description: Wall-clock time the session started, for humans only.

mono_ns.description: The monotonic clock at session start, as a decimal string of the integer.
mono_ns.$comment: brief v3 line 238; brief v4 line 238 (open point P1, decided 2026-11-16)

code_fingerprint.description: A fingerprint of Orunmila's own code at session start; a change mid-session is a tampering mark.
code_fingerprint.$comment: agent: ledger A3 and NF41, phase1-plan A10; not in brief line 282

version.description: The agent's version, null when unknown.

accounts.description: User accounts: the agent's, and the one Orunmila's files belong to (the same account until the separate-user setup in Phase 5).

agent_user.description: The account the agent runs as.

orunmila_user.description: The account that owns Orunmila's logs.

project_root.description: The session header records the project root, so a Glove mark and a sentinel mark for one file always join.
project_root.$comment: brief v3 line 339. An absolute path (POSIX, or a Windows drive).

config.description: Every configured value (quiet window, ceiling, lag grace, exclusions).
config.$comment: brief v3 line 282; other configured values are allowed beside these

diff_size_limit_bytes.description: The size limit over which a diff is not kept (`no_diff: too_large`), a configured value recorded in the session header.

case_insensitive.description: Whether the project root's file system ignores case, as the intake probed it at session start. Intake lower-cases every mark's path and the baseline's on such a root (line 345), so replay folds a claim's path the same way before matching it; absent in headers written before the field existed, where replay cannot tell and matches as it did then.
case_insensitive.$comment: agent's proposal (LD227), approved by O as Q25 (2026-11-23, "ok, go"), LD233; brief v4 lines 283, 345, 859 rule 4

byproducts.description: The byproducts list (`.orunmila/byproducts`) as it was at session start: one entry per line, trimmed, blank lines and `#` comments left out, matched as the ignore list's entries are. Its fingerprint is `frozen.byproducts`, of the same bytes. Absent when the header does not carry the list (the live path off, slice A1a); station 5 then has no list to match.
byproducts.$comment: brief v4 lines 283, 349, 399; the list in the header is the agent's proposal (LD175, Q9), so replay reads it from the header and never from current settings

rules.description: The rules file (`.orunmila/rules`) as it was at session start, its text whole, so the judge and any re-judgement read the session's rules from the header and never from current settings. Its fingerprint is `frozen.rules`, of the same bytes. Absent when the file did not exist (the default rules judge the session) or the judge was off.
rules.$comment: brief v4 lines 283, 664, 684; agent's proposal, Q34 (approved by O 2026-11-24, LD262): copied by the intake, parsed only by the judge

watch_extra.description: The folders outside the project that this session's Sentinel also watched (ORUNMILA_WATCH_EXTRA), each its real absolute path with `/` separators, as an outside mark's path is written, sorted. A file there with no Sentinel mark is `saw_nothing`, not `out_of_scope`. Absent when the Sentinel watched no extra folder (the default).
watch_extra.$comment: brief v4 lines 283, 347; agent's proposal, Q42 (approved by O 2026-11-25, LD299; LD289, LD328)

frozen.description: The fingerprints of every frozen configuration file (rules, byproducts, ignore list, law packs, agent hook settings) as they were at session start. null when the file does not exist.

law_packs.description: Every law pack in use (Orunmila's canon and any project law pack), by name.

hook_settings.description: The agent's own hook configuration files, by path. A change mid-session is recorded as a tampering mark; it cannot be held back (NF42, approved by O 2026-11-15).
hook_settings.$comment: brief v3 line 343, as amended for hook settings by O's NF42 decision

hooks_report.description: Which tool calls the agent's hooks can report before and after they run. Where an agent cannot report before a tool runs, the session header says so.
hooks_report.$comment: brief v3 lines 282, 337. Each list holds tool names, or "*" for every tool (agent's choice, LD16); an empty list means none.

test_command.description: The project's own test command as it was at session start, and a fingerprint of the scripts block that decides what it runs. Configuration is frozen at session start: a change to the block mid-session is a tampering mark (`frozen_config`) and does not take effect until the next session. Every value is null when none was found.
test_command.$comment: agent: slice B8, proposed in writing to O (brief v4 line 859, rule 4) and approved 2026-11-18 ("If you're sure b8 is the best choice, lets go"), narrowed by LD70 from the whole file to its scripts block; grounded in brief v4 lines 283 and 349

text.description: The test command, redacted like every other text the log holds; null when none was found.
text.$comment: agent: LD70; redaction as brief v4 line 249

source.description: Where the command was read from; null with no command.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root (today always `package.json`).

key.description: The entry in that file (today always `scripts.test`).

scripts_fingerprint.description: Plain SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of package.json's whole scripts block, its string values redacted first; null when the block is unknown.
scripts_fingerprint.$comment: agent: LD70; a test script can run other scripts, so the whole block is frozen

baseline.description: The baseline snapshot taken at session start: a fingerprint of every file in the workspace, kept beside the log as `baseline.jsonl` (one canonical JSON line per entry, sorted by path). The walk skips what `config.exclusions` names, so the exclusion itself is in this header. Its fingerprint is here, so the hash chain covers it too. Absent when no snapshot was taken.
baseline.$comment: brief v4 lines 385, 387; the field's name and shape are the agent's (LD170). Counts of entries and bytes are left out: the brief does not name them and the file gives them

prev_hash.description: The hash chain starts from the header, so it has no previous hash.

hash.description: The header's own hash; the first mark's prev_hash.

fingerprint.description: Plain SHA-256, or keyed HMAC-SHA-256 for files on the redaction list; null when the file does not exist.
